design.ordinary_group_expression: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.diagnostic && format('read-only-job-diagnostic-{0}-{1}', github.run_id, github.run_attempt) || format('repository-output-writer-{0}', github.ref)
design.overflow: Additional arrivals beyond the documented queue capacity are canceled.
design.ordinary_checkout: Current github.ref after acquiring branch writer queue
design.original_selection: BEFORE=github.event.before and AFTER=github.sha retained unchanged for event selection
design.native_provenance: GITHUB_SHA is overridden only for native execution with git rev-parse HEAD; manifests and STATUS bind actual checkout
design.diagnostics: Unique run/attempt group, event SHA checkout, no publication or persisted checkout credentials
design.refresh: Existing trusted-main job guard retained; same main writer queue; latest-main checkout after lock; fixed checker/tracker/digest selection
design.freshness: No publisher, input scope, source gate, packet, claim, review or status changes
design.existing_triggers: All push, schedule, manual and workflow_run triggers retained
design.duplication: A mixed code push and subsequent Run jobs completion can still request two reporting trios. They now serialize rather than invalidate production; no polling framework or broader job fanout is added.
